title: Hanuma sees Seetha with ogresses
introduction: In this chapter Hanuma sees Seetha surrounded by ogresses.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तदशः सर्गः
Thus completes 17th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कुमुदषण्डाभो निर्मलम् निर्मलोदयः |
प्रजगाम नभश्चन्द्रो हंसो नीलमिवोदकम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kumudaṣaṇḍābho nirmalam nirmalodayaḥ |
prajagāma nabhaścandro haṃso nīlamivodakam
verses.translation: Thereafter the moon with a peaceful rise, with radiance equaling that of a group of lotuses, obtained the clear sky like a swan obtaining blue water.

glosses.meaning: with radiance equaling that of a group of lotuses

verses.devanagari:
साचिव्यमिव कुर्वन् स प्रभया निर्मलप्रभः |
चन्द्रमा रश्मभिः शीतैः सिषेवे पवनात्मजम्
verses.iast:
sācivyamiva kurvan sa prabhayā nirmalaprabhaḥ |
candramā raśmabhiḥ śītaiḥ siṣeve pavanātmajam
verses.translation: That moon with a peaceful glow served Hanuma with cool rays as though performing help with radiance.

verses.devanagari:
स ददर्श ततः सीताम् पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् |
शोकभारैरिव न्यस्तां भारैर्नावमिवाम्भसि
verses.iast:
sa dadarśa tataḥ sītām pūrṇacandranibhānanām |
śokabhārairiva nyastāṃ bhārairnāvamivāmbhasi
verses.translation: Thereafter Hanuma saw Seetha with a face like a full moon, put down by the weight of grief, like a ship sinking down in water due to weight.

glosses.meaning: with face like a full moon

verses.devanagari:
दिदृक्षमाणो वैदेहीम् हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः |
स ददर्शाविदूरस्था राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः
एकाक्षीमेककर्णाम् च कर्णप्रावरणाम् तथा |
अकर्णाम् शङ्कुकर्णाम् च मस्तकोच्छ्वासनासिकाम्
अतिकायोत्तमाङ्गीं च तनुदीर्घशिरोधराम् |
ध्वस्तकेशीम् तथाकेशीम् केशकम्बलधारिणीम्
लम्बकर्णललाटाम् च लम्बोदरपयोधराम् |
लम्बोष्ठीं चुबुकोष्ठीं च लम्बास्याम् लम्बजानुकाम्
ह्रस्वाम् दीर्घाम् च कुब्जाम् विकटाम् वामनां तथा |
करालाम् भुग्नवक्त्राम् च पिङ्गाक्षीम् विकृताननाम्
verses.iast:
didṛkśamāṇo vaidehīm hanumān mārutātmajaḥ |
sa dadarśāvidūrasthā rākśasīrghoradarśanāḥ
ekākśīmekakarṇām ca karṇaprāvaraṇām tathā |
akarṇām śaṇ^kukarṇām ca mastakocchvāsanāsikām
atikāyottamāṇ^gīṃ ca tanudīrghaśirodharām |
dhvastakeśīm tathākeśīm keśakambaladhāriṇīm
lambakarṇalalāṭām ca lambodarapayodharām |
lamboṣṭhīṃ cubukoṣṭhīṃ ca lambāsyām lambajānukām
hrasvām dīrghām ca kubjām vikaṭām vāmanāṃ tathā |
karālām bhugnavaktrām ca piṇ^gākśīm vikṛtānanām
verses.translation: Hanuma wanting to see Seetha saw nearby ogresses with horrible appearance - one with one eye; one with a single ear and also one with ears as covering; one with conch shell like ears; one with fattened nose up to head; one with lean and long neck; one with disheveled hair and also one without hair; one with blanket like hair; one with hanging stomach and breasts; one with hanging face; one with lips at chin; one with hanging face; one with hanging knees; one who is short; one who is tall and also hunch backed one; one who is distorted; a dwarf one and also one with high teeth and one with crooked mouth, one with green eyes and one with a horrible face.

glosses.meaning: one with ears as covering body
one with fattened nose up to head
one with a lean and long neck
one with hair like a blanket
one with hanging stomach and breasts

verses.devanagari:
विकृताः पिङ्गलाः कालीः क्रोधनाः कलहप्रियाः |
कालायसमहाशूलकूटमुद्गधारिणीः
वराहमृगशार्दूलमहिषाजशिवामुखीः |
गजोष्ट्र हयपादीश्च निखातशिरसोपराः
एकहस्तैकपादाश्च खरकर्ण्यश्वकर्णिकाः |
गोकर्णीर्हस्तिकर्णीईश्च हरिकर्णीस्तथापराः
अतिनासाश्च तिर्यङ्नासा अनासिकाः |
गजनन्निभनासाश्च ललाटोच्च्वासनासिकाः
हस्तिपादा महापादा गोपादाः पादचूळिकाः |
अतिमात्रशिरोग्रीवा अतिमात्रकुचोदरीः
अतिमात्रस्यनेत्राश्च दीर्घजिह्वानखास्तथा |
अजामुखीर्हस्तिमुखीर्गोमुखाः सूकरीमुखीः
हयोष्ट्रखरवक्त्राश्च राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः |
शूलमुद्गरहस्ताश्च क्रोधनाः कलहप्रियाः
कराळा धूम्रकेशीश्च राक्षसीर्विकृताननाः |
पिबन्तीः सततं पानं सदा मां ससुराप्रियाः
मांसशोणितदिग्धाङ्गीर्मांसशोणितभोजनाः |
ता ददर्श कपिश्रेष्ठो रोमहर्षणदर्शनाः
स्कन्धवन्तमुपासीनाः परिवार्य वनस्पतिम् |
verses.iast:
vikṛtāḥ piṇ^galāḥ kālīḥ krodhanāḥ kalahapriyāḥ |
kālāyasamahāśūlakūṭamudgadhāriṇīḥ
varāhamṛgaśārdūlamahiṣājaśivāmukhīḥ |
gajoṣṭra hayapādīśca nikhātaśirasoparāḥ
ekahastaikapādāśca kharakarṇyaśvakarṇikāḥ |
gokarṇīrhastikarṇIIśca harikarṇīstathāparāḥ
atināsāśca tiryaṇ^nāsā anāsikāḥ |
gajanannibhanāsāśca lalāṭoccvāsanāsikāḥ
hastipādā mahāpādā gopādāḥ pādacūLikāḥ |
atimātraśirogrīvā atimātrakucodarīḥ
atimātrasyanetrāśca dīrghajihvānakhāstathā |
ajāmukhīrhastimukhīrgomukhāḥ sūkarīmukhīḥ
hayoṣṭrakharavaktrāśca rākśasīrghoradarśanāḥ |
śūlamudgarahastāśca krodhanāḥ kalahapriyāḥ
karāLā dhūmrakeśīśca rākśasīrvikṛtānanāḥ |
pibantīḥ satataṃ pānaṃ sadā māṃ sasurāpriyāḥ
māṃsaśoṇitadigdhāṇ^gīrmāṃsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ |
tā dadarśa kapiśreṣṭho romaharṣaṇadarśanāḥ
skandhavantamupāsīnāḥ parivārya vanaspatim |
verses.translation: Hanuma saw horrible ogresses, dark complexioned ones, angry ones, those who like quarrels, ones wearing big darts, mallets and clubs of iron, with faces like those of pigs, deer, tigers, buffaloes, goats, she-foxes, with feet like those of elephants, camels, horses, with heads sunk into bodies, with single hand and single foot, those ears like that of donkeys and horses, those with cow ears, those with elephant ears, those with monkey ears, and some others without nose, those with horizontal nose, those with crooked nose, those with elephant-like nose, toes with nose fixed in forehead, with feet like those of elephant, those with big feet, those with cow like feet, those with hair on their feet, those with big heads and necks, those with big nipples and big stomach, those with big eyes and mouths, with long tongues and nails, and also the a face like that of a she-goat, those with elephant like face, those with face like that of a cow, those with face of a she-pig, those with faces like those of horses, camels, donkeys, those with horrible appearance, ogresses carrying pikes and clubs in their hand, angry ones, those who like quarrels, those with high teeth, with hair color like that of smoke, with horrible faces, always drinking liquor, always desiring meat and liquor, with body smeared by meat and blood, with meat and blood as food, whose appearance made hair to stand up, sitting around a great tree with huge trunk.

glosses.itrans: varaaha mR^iga shaarduula mahishhaa shivaa mukhiiH
glosses.iast: varāha mṛga śārdūla mahiśhā śivā mukhīḥ
glosses.devanagari: वराह मृग शार्दूल महिश्हा शिवा मुखीः
glosses.meaning: with faces like those of pigs
with feet like those of elephants
with a single hand and those with single foot
those with donkey ears and horse ears
with feet like those of elephant
those with hair on their feet
those with big heads and necks
those with big nipples and big stomach
those with big mouths and eyes
those with face like that of a she-goat
those with face like that of a cow
those with face of a she-pig
with faces like those of horses
carrying pikes and clubs in their hand
with hair color like that of smoke
with body smeared by meat and blood
with meat and blood as food
whose appearance made hair to stand up

verses.devanagari:
तस्याधस्ताच्च ताम् देवीम् राजपुत्रीमनिन्दिताम्
लक्षयामास लक्ष्मीवान् हनुमान् जन्कात्मजाम् |
verses.iast:
tasyādhastācca tām devīm rājaputrīmaninditām
lakṣayāmāsa lakṣmīvān hanumān jankātmajām |
verses.translation: Hanuma the glorious one saw that Seetha, the princess, daughter of Janaka, unblemished one below that tree.

verses.devanagari:
निष्प्रभाम् षोकसन्तप्ताम् मलसम्कुलमूर्धजाम्
क्षीणपुण्याम् च्युताम् भूमौ ताराम् निपतितामिव |
verses.iast:
niṣprabhām ṣokasantaptām malasamkulamūrdhajām
kśīṇapuṇyām cyutām bhūmau tārām nipatitāmiva |
verses.translation: She was lack luster being tormented by grief, with hair covered by dirt, with merits exhausted, like star fallen from heavens onto ground.
She was rich with fame of lofty character, poor due to not seeing husband, lacking excellent ornaments, with husband's love as ornament.

glosses.meaning: poor due to not seeing husband

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसाधिपसम्रुद्धाम् बन्धुभिश्च विना कृताम्
वियूथाम् सिम्हसम्रुद्धाम् बद्धाम् गजवधूमिव |
verses.iast:
rākśasādhipasamruddhām bandhubhiśca vinā kṛtām
viyūthām simhasamruddhām baddhām gajavadhūmiva |
verses.translation: Being held captive by Ravana, without any relatives, She was like a she-elephant without herd, being detained by a lion.
She was like moon being covered by clouds at the end of rainy season with an appearance lacking lustre due to lack of contact with husband, was like an unplucked Veena.

glosses.meaning: at the end of rainy season
due to lack of contact (with husband)

verses.devanagari:
स ताम् भर्तवशे युक्तामयुक्ताम् राक्षसीवशे
अशोकवनिकामध्ये शोकसागरमाप्लुताम् |
verses.iast:
sa tām bhartavaśe yuktāmayuktām rākśasīvaśe
aśokavanikāmadhye śokasāgaramāplutām |
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Seetha being suited to be with her husband, in the custody of ogresses, in the middle of Ashoka garden being immersed in an ocean of grief

glosses.meaning: being suited to be with her husband
in the middle of Ashoka garden

verses.devanagari:
ताभिः परिवृताम् तत्र सग्रहामिव रोहिणीम्
ददर्श हनुमान् देवीम् लतामकुसुमामिव |
verses.iast:
tābhiḥ parivṛtām tatra sagrahāmiva rohiṇīm
dadarśa hanumān devīm latāmakusumāmiva |
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Seetha there surrounded by those ogresses, like Rohini with planets, like a creeper without flowers.

verses.devanagari:
सा मलेन च दिग्धाङ्गीवपुषा चाप्यलंकृता
मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति च न भाति च |
verses.iast:
sā malena ca digdhāṇ^gīvapuṣā cāpyalaṅkṛtā
mṛṇālī paṇ^kadigdheva vibhāti ca na bhāti ca |
verses.translation: With body smeared with dirt, being graced by Her body, that Seetha shone and also did not shine, like a lotus-fibre covered with dirt.

verses.devanagari:
मलिनेन तु वस्त्रेण परिक्लिष्टेन भामिनीम्
संवृताम् मृगशाबाक्षीं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः |
ताम् देवीं दीनवदनामदीनां भर्तृतेजसा
रक्षिताम् स्वेन शीलेन सीतामसितलोचनाम् |
verses.iast:
malinena tu vastreṇa parikliṣṭena bhāminīm
saṃvṛtām mṛgaśābākśīṃ dadarśa hanumān kapiḥ |
tām devīṃ dīnavadanāmadīnāṃ bhartṛtejasā
rakśitām svena śīlena sītāmasitalocanām |
verses.translation: The monkey Hanuma saw that Seetha with great beauty with black eyes, covered by a cloth which was creased and dirty, with eyes of a deer, with a pitiful face, not depressed due to the brilliance of her husband, protected by her own character.

glosses.meaning: due to the brilliance of husband

verses.devanagari:
ताम् दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् सीताम् मृगशाबनिभेक्षणाम् |
मृगकन्यामिव त्रस्ताम् वीक्षमाणाम् समन्ततः
दहन्तीमिव निःश्वासैर्वृक्षान् पल्लवधारिणः |
सम्घातमिव शोकानाम् दुःखस्योर्मिमिवोथिताम्
verses.iast:
tām dṛṣṭvā hanumān sītām mṛgaśābanibhekśaṇām |
mṛgakanyāmiva trastām vīkśamāṇām samantataḥ
dahantīmiva niḥśvāsairvṛkṣān pallavadhāriṇaḥ |
samghātamiva śokānām duḥkhasyormimivothitām
verses.translation: Hanuma became happy on seeing Seetha with eyes of a fawn, fearful like a she-deer, seeing trees with young shoots, as though being burnt by sighs, like a bundle of grief, with a wave of sorrow risen up.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् क्षमां सुविभक्ताङ्गीं विनाभरणशोभिनीम् |
प्रहर्षमतुलम् लेभे मारुतिः प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम्
verses.iast:
tām kśamāṃ suvibhaktāṇ^gīṃ vinābharaṇaśobhinīm |
praharṣamatulam lebhe mārutiḥ prekṣya maithilīm
verses.translation: Hanuma the son of wind god on seeing Seetha that Seetha like the goddess earth, with well divided body parts shining eve without ornaments, obtained great joy.

verses.devanagari:
हर्षजानि च सोऽश्रूणि ताम् दृष्ट्वा मदिरेक्षणाम् |
मुमुचे हनुमांस्तत्र नमश्चक्रे च राघवम्
verses.iast:
harṣajāni ca so'śrūṇi tām dṛṣṭvā madirekṣaṇām |
mumuce hanumāṃstatra namaścakre ca rāghavam
verses.translation: Hanuma on seeing Seetha there with intoxicating eyes shed tears of joy and also paid obeisance to Sri Rama.

verses.devanagari:
नमस्कृत्वा रामाय लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान् |
सीतादर्शनसम्हृष्टो हनुमान् सम्वृतोऽभवत्
verses.iast:
namaskṛtvā rāmāya lakśmaṇāya ca vīryavān |
sītādarśanasamhṛṣṭo hanumān samvṛto'bhavat
verses.translation: Being joyful on seeing Seetha, Hanuma the mighty one paid obeisance to Sri Rama and to Lakshmana and became covered with leaves.
